people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.
translations.bsb: “Good,” said Saul to his servant. “Come, let us go.” So they set out for the city where the man of God was.
translations.kjv: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
